articles.title: BofA Awards $1 Million to Rebuild Pacific Palisades YMCA Destroyed in Wildfires
articles.mainIdea: BofA Awards $1 Million to Rebuild Pacific Palisades YMCA Destroyed in Wildfires
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BofA Awards $1 Million to Rebuild Pacific Palisades YMCA Destroyed in Wildfires. In recognition of the one-year anniversary of the Los Angeles wildfires, Bank of America announced a $1 million grant to the YMCA of Metropolitan Los Angeles to help rebuild the Lowe Family YMCA serving the Palisades-Malibu community that was destroyed by the fires. The BofA grant is the first and largest corporate award to date for the YMCA's $25 million capital campaign that was launched over the summer.
